# Arity

<!-- badges: start -->
[![R-CMD-check](https://github.com/jolars/arity-r/actions/workflows/R-CMD-check.yaml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/jolars/arity-r/actions/workflows/R-CMD-check.yaml)
<!-- badges: end -->

`arity` provides R bindings to the formatter behind [arity](https://arity.cc).
The package embeds the published
[`arity-formatter`](https://docs.rs/arity-formatter) Rust crate; it
does not invoke the `arity` command-line interface.

Format source held in memory:

```{r}
#| label: load-arity

library(arity)

format_text("x<-(1+2)*3^4\n")
```

Or format one file in place:

```r
changed <- format_file("R/example.R")
```
